propositions: Push-triggered main CI runs on the mirror are cancelled when commits land close together, causing GitHub to display red X marks on a healthy main branch
The scheduled main-health CI runs every 6 hours (not on push) to report aggregate main health rather than per-commit status, eliminating cancellation artifacts
The last-known-green main SHA is resolved from the Actions API and published with a git bisect run recipe when main is unhealthy

Six workflows are evaluated for trigger policy: test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, and terraform-drift.yml are modified to remove main-push triggers while preserving non-main branch CI
Non-main branch push CI is preserved for all four branches-ignore workflows
Gerrit pre-merge verification remains unchanged; the main CI change affects only the post-merge safety-net cadence
